findings.title: One aggregate completeness bit couples memory safety to transient ps task/thread data
findings.evidence: Runner.group_activity demands every row's RSS/CPU/state be complete in one of three closely spaced snapshots; Runner.run aborts otherwise. The observed failure retains rising known CPU/RSS lower bounds and recent log progress.
findings.limit: This proves an observation failure, not a stalled workload. Normalized IDs do not establish whether the three unknown rows represent one persistent process or different processes.
findings.minimalChange: Use task-level measurements bound to identity for every inventoried owned PID. Keep unknown values explicit and maintain bounded retry/failure; do not require ps thread-state collection for the memory gate.

findings.title: Existing out-of-group RSS and liveness helpers can silently turn unavailability into absence or zero
findings.evidence: MacProcesses.rss returns zero for empty/nondecimal ps output. MacProcesses.info returns None on some short/error returns, including errno zero; describe/live can then omit that process before RSS is probed.
findings.minimalChange: Use the shared probe for RSS with expected generation, and tighten BSD liveness so only proven gone/zombie generations disappear. Unsupported/permission/short results remain unavailable and prevent allOwnedGone or memory-complete success.

findings.title: Diagnostics lose per-generation continuity
findings.evidence: Every normalized example uses the same placeholder PID, so the failure does not distinguish churn from repeated unavailability for the same generation.
findings.minimalChange: Retain a bounded run-local opaque identity tag derived from PID plus precise birth, without raw arguments, private paths, nonce or token.

sharedProbeDesign.name: PROC_PIDTASKALLINFO
sharedProbeDesign.returnContract: Clear errno before the call. Accept only exactly 232 bytes plus matching PID/UID/PGID/birth and coherent valid user-task fields. A full zeroed or inconsistent record is unavailable; a short/zero return with errno zero is not a measured zero.
proposedValidLiveConditions: expected PID/UID/PGID and precise generation match
positive virtual size and thread count
zero RSS accepted only as a field of an otherwise valid measured live task
goneConditions: A successful BSD record explicitly establishes zombie status or that the expected generation no longer occupies the PID.
A positive-PID kill(pid,0) check fails with ESRCH.
unavailableConditions: zero or short result without independent gone evidence
identity mismatch or malformed field/ABI record
sharedProbeDesign.permissionPolicy: No credentials, entitlement changes, task-for-pid authorization changes, sudo or additional control signals. Existing kernel same-user and MAC policy checks remain effective.
sharedProbeDesign.cpu: The inspected kernel supplies Mach absolute-time counters. Convert with a successful positive numer/denom mach_timebase_info result, or compare raw same-generation counters without claiming seconds. Do not assume the counters are nanoseconds.
sharedProbeDesign.scheduling: numrunning > 0 establishes runnable threads for the stall guard. An S value for zero runnable threads must be labeled a derived task scheduling summary, not an observed ps sleep state.
sharedProbeDesign.bounds: Use bounded inventory size, bounded sampling attempts and a bounded diagnostic ring. Never sum unknown memory as zero.
sharedProbeDesign.safeguardsDuringUnknown: Do not feed incomplete CPU/state into a stall decision. Do not accrue unknown intervals as demonstrated inactivity. Disk/log/platform limits, known-RSS lower-bound exceedance and owned cleanup must remain active.

kernelValidityAssessment.taskFiller: The inspected Darwin-24-family implementation does not silently return an all-zero task record when task-port inspection fails; it locks the referenced task and fills map/ledger, policy, CPU and thread fields.
kernelValidityAssessment.flavor4: PROC_PIDTASKINFO uses the same internal task filler as TASKALLINFO, so changing flavors does not strengthen task-data validity.
kernelValidityAssessment.limitation: The RSS ledger read's return value is not exposed independently to the caller. Full returned size alone is therefore not an unconditional field-validity proof.
kernelValidityAssessment.normalKernelInvariant: The inspected task initializer requires creation of the physical-memory ledger entry and instantiates active entries; missing allocation prevents task creation. Coherent live-task fields and target preflight are required before treating RSS zero as measured zero.
kernelValidityAssessment.exactRunnerKernelSourceMatch: UNVERIFIED; the inspected public xnu-11417.140.69 release is a Darwin-24-family source reference, not a verified source-to-binary mapping for 24G830.

requiredAcceptance: Portable guards cover exact/full and short/zero/error responses, measured-zero versus unknown, permission failure, PID reuse, mismatched generation, lifecycle omission and missing RSS.
Early macOS preflight verifies 136/96/232 layout, identity/timebase/self RSS, and complete task-level observations during owned process churn before source checkout or build.
An unavailable live-process memory measurement still fails after bounded observation; task startup/exit races cannot be promised to vanish.
Old failed runs remain failures and prior Recovery2 Host TU/XUL build evidence remains separate. New source/immutable route must be reviewed before any additional execution.
